certificate.definition: For every allowed S and token pair u,v: ||F_S(u)-F_S(v)-A(z_u-z_v)||_2 <= p_upper.
certificate.reference: Exact affine W8 coefficients; real arithmetic, exact RMSNorm eps from config decimal; real orthogonal RoPE.
certificate.domain: All vocabulary IDs as current text tokens and all finite causal reference prefixes; same S and position for each pair.
certificate.metric: Standard L2 of dequantized real K,V; K de-rotated at the known position; not RMS or integer-code LSB.

anchor.definition: A_head z = eta * (D_gamma_head W_head D_gamma_input) * scalar_product_before_KV * z_main; z_main=sqrt(hidden_size)*embedding[token]. All PLE columns of A are zero; their full effect is in p.

scope_notes: This is an upper bound for this explicit A, not a unique model-intrinsic p.
Attention, FFN and PLE use their post-RMSNorm range; their internal weights are validated but need not appear numerically in this universal range bound.
Q/K logits, GQA, window length and earlier shared cache contents cannot invalidate the post-norm range bound.
PLE features are included in the remainder, not assumed absent or token-independent.
Later layers do not affect earlier KV producers. Reused KVs are aliases, not new KV outputs.
Current image/audio embeddings and multimodal encoders, BF16 rounding, KV8 rounding and NPU execution are outside this reference certificate.
Packed codes of internal branch matrices need not be hashed: the theorem holds for every code assignment with finite validated metadata.
